scripts.build: rm -rf dist && npm run db:generate && tsc && tsc-alias
scripts.test: npm run typecheck && npm run test:api && npm run test:front
scripts.test:api: RUST_LOG=debug NODE_ENV=test DATABASE_URL=file:./src/database/db.test.sqlite npm run db:drop && NODE_ENV=test DATABASE_URL=file:./src/database/db.test.sqlite npm run db:seed && NODE_ENV=test DATABASE_URL=file:./src/database/db.test.sqlite node --import tsx --test test/api/*.test.ts
scripts.db:load: npm run db:migrate && npm run db:seed
scripts.db:reload: npm run db:drop && npm run db:seed
scripts.db:studio: npx -p better-sqlite3 -p prisma prisma studio --url file:./dev.db
